blocks.text: Hydrocarbons organic compounds ki woh qism hain jo sirf carbon aur hydrogen par mushtamil hain. Yeh petroleum aur natural gas mein bohat zyada milte hain aur gharelu aur sanati fuels ke taur par wasee istemal hote hain, aur un ke bohat se synthetic istemalat hain: unsaturated hydrocarbons, khaas taur par alkenes, bohat se sanati products ka khaam maal (starting material) hain, aur zyada tar dawaiyan, plastics, perfumes aur polymers hydrocarbons hi se nikle hain. Hydrocarbons mote taur par do qismon mein bat-te hain, aliphatic aur aromatic.

blocks.title: Aliphatic hydrocarbons
blocks.text: Jo compounds aromatic nahi woh aliphatic kehlate hain. Aliphatic compounds khuli zanjeer (open chain) ya cyclic, aur saturated ya unsaturated ho sakte hain; agar un mein sirf carbon aur hydrogen hon to woh aliphatic hydrocarbons hain. Alkanes acyclic aliphatic hydrocarbons hain, cycloalkanes cyclic aliphatic hydrocarbons, aur alkenes aur alkynes acyclic, unsaturated aliphatic hydrocarbons (Figure 11.1: methane, ethane, ethene, ethyne, cyclopropane, cyclobutane, cyclopentane, cyclohexane).

blocks.alt: Aath aliphatic hydrocarbons ki saakht naamon ke saath. Oopar: methane, ethane, ethene aur ethyne, har bond dikhaya gaya; ethene mein C=C double bond aur ethyne mein H-C triple bond C-H. Neeche: cyclopropane, cyclobutane, cyclopentane aur cyclohexane, CH2 groups ke halqe (H2C, CH2 ya H2 ke saath C likha).
blocks.caption: Figure 11.1: Aliphatic hydrocarbons (kitab ki Figure 11.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Aromatic hydrocarbons
blocks.text: Aromatic hydrocarbons cyclic hydrocarbons ki khaas qism hain jin mein carbon aur hydrogen ka tanasub ooncha hai aur jo benzene (C6H6) ya us se milte julte compounds par mabni hain. Benzene bunyadi aromatic compound hai; toluene aur phenol us ke mushtaqat (derivatives) hain (Figure 11.2: benzene, methylbenzene, ethylbenzene). Lafz aromatic Greek 'aroma', khushboodar, se aaya hai, in compounds ki khaas boo ki wajah se.

blocks.alt: Teen chhe-rukni halqe jin mein single aur double bonds baari baari aate hain, konon par HC, CH aur C: benzene (halqe ke oopar aur neeche H), methylbenzene (oopar wale carbon par CH3) aur ethylbenzene (oopar wale carbon par CH2-CH3).
blocks.caption: Figure 11.2: Kuch aromatic hydrocarbons (kitab ki Figure 11.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Benzene ke halqe mein har kone par ek carbon hai; HC ya CH ka matlab hai us carbon par ek hydrogen. Single aur double bonds baari baari (alternate) dikhaye gaye hain. Methylbenzene aur ethylbenzene mein oopar wale carbon ka hydrogen CH3 ya CH2-CH3 group se badal gaya hai, is liye wahan H nahi likha.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 11.2 mein ethylbenzene ke halqe ka oopar daen wala bond toota hua chhapa hai. Benzene ka halqa hamesha mukammal (chhe carbon, band) hota hai, is liye oopar khaake mein poora halqa banaya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt: Aliphatic aur aromatic hydrocarbons mein farq batayein, aur cyclohexane, ethyne aur toluene ki qism tay karein (exercise Q.2b).
blocks.explanation: Aliphatic hydrocarbons woh hain jo benzene ke halqe par mabni nahi: khuli zanjeer ya cyclic, saturated ya unsaturated, jaise cyclohexane (cyclic saturated aliphatic hydrocarbon) aur ethyne (acyclic unsaturated). Aromatic hydrocarbons mein benzene ka halqa hota hai, ooncha carbon-hydrogen tanasub, jaise toluene (methylbenzene).

items: Hydrocarbons: sirf C aur H; petroleum aur natural gas se fuels; alkenes sanati khaam maal.
Aliphatic = aromatic nahi (alkanes acyclic, cycloalkanes cyclic, alkenes aur alkynes unsaturated). Aromatic = benzene par mabni halqe oonche C : H tanasub ke saath (benzene, toluene, ethylbenzene).
